name: Alicante-Elche Miguel Hernández Airport

hours.v: Airport, ATS, fuel and handling 24 hours

slots.v: Prior airport slot mandatory for all general and business aviation; requests accepted only up to 15 days ahead
slots.quote: Mandatory application for prior airport slot clearance for all General and Business Aviation flights

noise.v: No engine tests above idle and no training flights 23:00–06:00 local
noise.quote: Training flights are prohibited between 23:00 and 06:00 LT.

notes: Read AIP España AD 2-LEAL (PDF, AIRAC AMDT 09/26, WEF 01 Oct 2026). Open H24, no night curfew for jets stated (piston aircraft are restricted by schedule). Slot mandatory for GA/business aviation, accepted only 15 days ahead. The page also says a handling agent is required for all operations (AD 2.4), not quoted here.
